drblroot.description: DRBL root directory for client-specific files

url_prefix.description: Prefix URL for DRBL-related resources and documentation

buffer_ratio_for_client_space.description: Buffer ratio for disk space calculations (client filesystem)

lib_NOT_2_be_copied_2_common_root.description: Directories in /lib excluded from being copied to common root
